title: APPEAL/1/2025 — SNG REAL ESTATE PRIVATE LIMITED vs. AADITYA ARYA SONI
text:
Court of the Presiding Officer
Debts Recovery Tribunal, Jaipur
Item No. 27
Case No. APPEAL/1/2025 IN OA/408/2021
SNG REAL ESTATE PRIVATE LIMITED Vs AADITYA ARYA SONI
Date: 05.02.2025.
Proceedings through hybrid mode
Present:
Shri Naresh Kumar Sejwani, Counsel for the Applicant
Shri Akshat Kulshreshtha, Counsel for the Respondent Bank/FI
In this matter, Recovery Certificate was drawn in OA no.
408/2021 and the dispute in the appeal is in respect to two properties
i.e. Flat no. G-1, Ground Floor, Shyam Pushp, James Colony,
Vidhyadhar Nagar, Jaipur and Flat No. 302, Third Floor, Shyam
Pushp, James Colony, Vidhyadhar Nagar, Jaipur.
The appellant is aggrieved with the order dated 19.12.2024
wherein the Ld. Recovery Officer deviate from the Recovery
Certificate and entered into alien terrirtory and has started
adjudicating upon the dispute between the appellant and Raghuraj
Buildhome Pvt. Ltd. None of the two parties are CDs and none of the
two properties are mentioned in Recovery Certificate or belong to
CDs.
Order of Ld. Recovery Officer per se does not seem to be a
legal orders and he cannot venture into anything more than the
Recovery Certificate as the properties were neither mentioned in the
Recovery Certificate nor owned by CDs, therefore, the order passed
by Recovery Officer dated 19.12.2024 stands quashed.
*

Court of the Presiding Officer
Debts Recovery Tribunal, Jaipur
Since the property does not belong to any of the CDs, the attachment
order also stands vacated. Appeal allowed in above terms.
Copy of the order be sent to the Ld. Recovery Officer.
File be consigned to record, as per rules. Copy of order be
uploaded on website.
(Vimal Gupta)
Presiding Officer
Debts Recovery Tribunal, Jaipur
*
